abstract: Verifies indemnity provisions, underwriter guarantees, and marine operational liability covers
system_message:
You are the Commercial risk manager (CRM), responsible for reviewing indemnity provisions, underwriter guarantees, and marine operational liability covers, as well as evaluating performance bond underwriting terms across candidate consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Verifies indemnity provisions, underwriter guarantees, and marine operational liability covers（RISK）
information_points.content:
CRM-RISK-7VA：Zeeland Dynamic Interconnector Group does not have financial liability insurance clearance, as its policy does not meet the confirmed 50 million GBP underwritten coverage threshold for third-party submarine asset collision and environmental pollution claims.
CRM-RISK-5BA：For Nordic Trench Marine Alliance, financial liability insurance clearance is confirmed, with a valid marine liability policy meeting the minimum 50 million GBP underwritten coverage for third-party submarine asset collision and environmental pollution claims.
CRM-RISK-UJK：Caledonian Subsea Solutions holds valid financial liability insurance clearance, supported by an underwritten marine liability policy satisfying the minimum 50 million GBP coverage requirement for third-party submarine asset collision and environmental pollution claims.

information_points.title: Performance bond underwriting（BOND）
information_points.content:
CRM-BOND-I2O：Nordic Trench Marine Alliance maintains a surety bond coverage ratio of 25% of the total base contract value under its financial guarantee indenture.
CRM-BOND-67K：Caledonian Subsea Solutions maintains a surety bond coverage ratio of 15% of the total base contract value based on its financial guarantee indenture.
CRM-BOND-DKK：Zeeland Dynamic Interconnector Group provides an irrevocable surety bond coverage ratio of 10% of the total base contract value according to its financial guarantee indenture.
